# FG-REVIEW-0030

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 409 |
| 重大度 | info |
| Runbook | なし |
| 発生させるテスト | `a_revert_that_conflicts_opens_nothing` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: このマージを取り消すと、その後の変更と衝突します。取り消しのマージリクエストは作りませんでした。手元で git revert して衝突を直してください。
- en: Reverting this merge conflicts with changes made after it. No revert merge request was opened. Run git revert locally and resolve the conflicts.
- id: Membatalkan merge ini berkonflik dengan perubahan setelahnya. Merge request pembatalan tidak dibuat. Jalankan git revert secara lokal dan selesaikan konfliknya.

## 原因 (cause)

M4 C10 (plan 04 M-4, ADR-0024 Amendment C10): the revert of the merge (`merge-tree` of the target's tip with the tip the merge was built on, the merged commit as the base — what `git revert -m 1` merges) conflicts in at least one path changed again after the merge. forge never commits conflict markers, so nothing was opened: no branch, no merge request (decided in ADR-0024 Amendment C10 — a draft with markers would be a broken change waiting to merge). The system's draft after a failed pipeline records the same outcome as `merge_request.revert_drafted` with `outcome=conflicted`, and the merge request's author is told.

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

The log event `forge.review.revert_conflicted` carries `project_id`, `merge_request_id`, `iid`, `merge_id`, `target_sha`, `conflict_files`, `files_truncated` and the conflicted paths (logs only, never in the answer).

## 対処 (fix)

Revert locally: `git revert -m 1 <merged commit>` (a merge commit) or `git revert <commit>` (a squash), resolve the conflicts, push a branch and open a merge request; or fix forward.
